shortDescription: Module for setup of ServerAutoScalePolicy Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: intelligent_autoscale
options.description: Use avi intelligent autoscale algorithm where autoscale is performed by comparing load on the pool against estimated capacity of all the servers. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: intelligent_scalein_margin
options.description: Maximum extra capacity as percentage of load used by the intelligent scheme. Scalein is triggered when available capacity is more than this margin. Allowed values are 1-99. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 40.

options.name: intelligent_scaleout_margin
options.description: Minimum extra capacity as percentage of load used by the intelligent scheme. Scaleout is triggered when available capacity is less than this margin. Allowed values are 1-99. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: max_scalein_adjustment_step
options.description: Maximum number of servers to scalein simultaneously. The actual number of servers to scalein is chosen such that target number of servers is always more than or equal to the min_size. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: max_scaleout_adjustment_step
options.description: Maximum number of servers to scaleout simultaneously. The actual number of servers to scaleout is chosen such that target number of servers is always less than or equal to the max_size. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 1.

options.name: max_size
options.description: Maximum number of servers after scaleout. Allowed values are 0-400.

options.name: min_size
options.description: No scale-in happens once number of operationally up servers reach min_servers. Allowed values are 0-400.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the object.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: scalein_alertconfig_refs
options.description: Trigger scalein when alerts due to any of these alert configurations are raised. It is a reference to an object of type alertconfig.

options.name: scalein_cooldown
options.description: Cooldown period during which no new scalein is triggered to allow previous scalein to successfully complete. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: scaleout_alertconfig_refs
options.description: Trigger scaleout when alerts due to any of these alert configurations are raised. It is a reference to an object of type alertconfig.

options.name: scaleout_cooldown
options.description: Cooldown period during which no new scaleout is triggered to allow previous scaleout to successfully complete. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: use_predicted_load
options.description: Use predicted load rather than current load. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Unique object identifier of the object.
